panels.title: 計測状況・最終受信（停止中や未取得を未使用と解釈しない）
panels.description: この新規ledgerへの計測範囲。過去履歴は未取込。受信停止時のゼロ利用は保証しません。queue/dropは運用statusコマンドで確認。

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, instance, measurement_start, last_event, last_received, now()-last_received AS receive_age, incomplete_records, unattributed_records FROM grafana.usage_health WHERE source='codex'

panels.title: 収集経路の状態・queue・失敗（再起動時にcounterはreset）
panels.description: 毎分の確認。観測時刻が古い／履歴がない期間は稼働不明です。forwarderの失敗counterはretryを含み、永久欠測件数とは一致しません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (component) component,observed_at,healthy,queue_bytes,failures FROM grafana.pipeline_health ORDER BY component,observed_at DESC

panels.title: 経路状態の履歴（最新500件・観測なしは未使用とみなさない）

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM grafana.pipeline_health WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 使用量内訳・粒度・失敗・未取得
panels.description: cacheはinputの内数、reasoningはoutputの内数。CLI turn数はLLM request数ではありません。token数はサブスク残量や確定請求額ではありません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT client,granularity, count(*) AS observed_records, count(*) FILTER(WHERE granularity='request') AS llm_attempts, count(DISTINCT turn_id) AS turns_with_id, count(*) FILTER(WHERE outcome='error') AS errors, count(*) FILTER(WHERE quality!='reported') AS incomplete, sum(input_tokens) AS input_including_cache, sum(output_tokens) AS output_including_reasoning, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cached_input_subset, sum(reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_output_subset, sum(total_tokens) AS known_total FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='codex' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY client,granularity

panels.title: 日別／時間帯別の既知トークン（JST境界）
panels.description: bucketでday/hour。欠測をゼロで埋めません。期間は右上で今日・7日・30日・任意期間へ変更できます。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc(${bucket:sqlstring},occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS time,client AS metric,sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='codex' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT instance,profile,model,provider,quality,sum(total_tokens) AS known_tokens,count(*) AS records FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='codex' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY known_tokens DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: turn/request明細（最新500件）
panels.description: Discord threadとHermes/Codex sessionは別識別子です。requestとturn累計を同時加算しません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at,received_at,user_id,thread_id,channel_id,session_id,turn_id,parent_turn_id,request_id,retry,granularity,outcome,quality,model,input_tokens,output_tokens,cache_read_tokens,reasoning_tokens,total_tokens FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='codex' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 500
